description: ASQA ambiguous question with 3 gold sub-questions.

turns.utterance: Who sings the song stuck in the middle with you?

gold_sub_intents: Who originally sang "Stuck in the Middle With You"?
Who sang "Stuck in the Middle with You" on the album Can't Explain?
Who sang "Stuck in the Middle With You" on the album Old Flame?
gold_passages: "Stuck in the Middle with You" (sometimes known as "Stuck in the Middle") is a song written by Scottish musicians Gerry Rafferty and Joe Egan and originally performed by their band Stealers Wheel.
Juice Newton recorded a version for her 1985 album, "Old Flame."
Leif Garrett released a version of the song on his 1980 album, "Can't Explain".
